EmailTemplate.description: Details for making an appointment at SCC to learn about transfer options
EmailTemplate.name: TRN SCC Schedule
EmailTemplate.subject: Schedule an appointment to discuss ASU transfer options at SCC!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in Arizona State University! You can schedule an appointment to discuss your ASU transfer options at Scottsdale Community College every Tuesday from 8:30 a.m. – 4:30 p.m. You can follow the directions below to schedule an appointment online.
Go to transfer.asu.edu/maricopa. Click Make an Appointment on the right-hand side of the page, choose Scottsdale Community College as your school and click Go. Available appointment times will appear on the calendar (Tuesdays only). For future weeks, click Next at the top of the calendar. Click Make an Appointment on the date and time that works best for you. Submit the contact form that appears. After submitting your contact information, be sure to confirm your time to make the appointment.
The ASU office at SCC is located in the Faculty Office Building, room 105 (FOB on the map). The FOB is on the southeast side of campus, right next to the snack bar and just north of the IT building. Come in through any door labeled Faculty Office Building. View campus map here: http://www.scottsdalecc.edu/about-scottsdale/college-maps-directions/scc-campus-map
Want another option to see what it’s like to be a Sun Devil? We’d love to speak to you on one of Arizona State University’s four campus locations to discuss your transfer options. Appointments are held Fridays from 8:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. Please follow the directions below to schedule an appointment online.
1. Go to http://transfer.asu.edu/friday/week. 2. Available appointment times will appear on the calendar (Fridays only). For future dates, use the drop-down option under View appointments by week, then click Go. 3. Click Make an appointment on the date and time that works best for you (the ASU office location will be listed before you schedule an appointment). Submit the contact form that appears. After submitting your contact information, be sure to confirm your time to make the appointment.
A confirmation email with the location will be emailed to you. While you’re on campus, we also hope you find your fit by scheduling a campus tour at http://visit.asu.edu.
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
